note: RBC Royal Bank only: CIBC Caribbean's card schedules for Trinidad and Tobago refused the request (403) on the host that serves them, and Republic Bank's weren't reached in this pass. RBC Royal Bank's page of personal credit cards for Trinidad and Tobago (read 30 October 2026), read in full: every card it offers individuals (4; the business cards, and the RBC Rewards Visa Platinum Black, offered only to Private Banking clients, a condition the game doesn't check, aren't written), each with its annual fee for the first card, its purchase rate a year and its cash advance rate a year. The page states no minimum payment, grace period, late fee or foreign transaction fee. Wave 4 (30 October 2026) added Scotiabank Trinidad and Tobago, one of the country's largest banks, whose credit card rates and fees page (rates and fees in effect from 9 December 2024, last updated December 2024) was read in full: its personal Mastercard (Scotiabank, Gold, MAGNA, AERO Black) and Visa (Classic, AERO Platinum) cards, in Trinidad and Tobago dollars, each with its annual interest rate (27.79% to 28.99%, written at the top with the bottom as the range's lowest; 26.20% on the AERO Black), its annual membership fee (the AERO Black's $4,200 a year, billed $350 a month, written as a monthly fee), a $100 late payment fee and $100 over-limit charge, a cash advance fee of 3.20%, at least $50, $50 for an NSF cheque, a minimum payment of 3%, at least $25, and an interest-free period of at least 21 days on purchases paid in full, written as 21. The page's rate after a missed minimum payment, up to 27.99%, is below its own top purchase rate, so it isn't written; the business cards and ScotiaLine (a line of credit) aren't written; it states no foreign currency charge. Tried and not used: Republic Bank's site didn't answer and First Citizens' refused the request (403). Wave 4 (30 October 2026) also added CIBC Caribbean, one of the region's largest banks, whose Trinidad schedule of charges for cards (effective december, 2019, last updated july 2026) its site now serves (an earlier pass found it refused or not linked): read in full, its personal credit cards (3), each with its annual fee for the primary card (none where the schedule gives 0.00 or Free; waived for the first year where the schedule says so), its yearly purchase rate, its cash advance rate and fee, its late payment, over-limit and returned cheque fees, the minimum payment where the schedule gives one, and its late payment rate as the penalty rate, as the earlier CIBC files do. Its business, corporate, commercial and Bizline cards aren't written, nor the replacement, statement, rush card, emergency payment and auto-payment charges, which a holder meets only by asking or by an auto-payment; the UWI cards are for the University of the West Indies' students, faculty and alumni, a condition the game doesn't check. It states no grace period or foreign transaction fee.
